Far front paw follows the SAME motion offset by four frames: its touchdown is frame 5, while near paw lifts. Both FRONT legs must visibly take turns, one supporting the heavy body as the other advances. Keep present travel range, no bigger gestures. Paws point down, elbows bend naturally, no striking or waving. Clear coherent differences from pose to pose. Each sprite remains one intact painted bear; no separated body parts. Maintain same 1536x1024 arrangement and generous clear gaps. Transparent PNG background, no checkerboard. All eight animals remain rear three-quarter facing upper left.
